messages:

Cc: procurement@cougartech.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Azure Marketplace private plan — terms exhibit and SOW

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Cougar Tech is moving forward with an Azure private plan and our procurement team has asked for the following to begin internal approvals:

- A draft "Azure Marketplace Private Offer Exhibit" that mirrors the commercial terms (prices, entitlements, billing flow) for our legal team to review.
- A short SOW that outlines onboarding milestones for entitlement provisioning and a target go-live date (we're aiming for end of Q1).
- Confirmation of co-sell revenue split and whether Redwood will allow marketplace billing to route to our tenant vs. reseller model.

Can you send a draft exhibit and SOW we can circulate? Procurement would like to see a version by next week if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that's easier.

Danielle Rivera
Head of Cloud Procurement
Cougar Tech
D: 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace private plan — terms exhibit and SOW

Hi Danielle — great to hear Cougar Tech is moving forward.

I've attached a first-pass exhibit (v1) and a brief SOW that reflects the onboarding milestones we discussed: entitlement provisioning, validation window, and initial usage ramp. Highlights:

- Pricing model: list price by entitlement (annual contract) with an annual true-up window.
- Entitlement provisioning: Azure tenancy-based entitlements with 7 business day provisioning SLA after purchase confirmation.
- Marketplace routing: we support both marketplace billing routed to customer tenant (via private offer) and reseller billing; routing impacts invoicing and co-sell reporting.
- Co-sell split: placeholder 70/30 (customer-facing ARR to Redwood) — we will confirm final split after internal review.

Next steps I propose:
1) Legal redlines on Exhibit v1 (deadline: 2026-12-09 for your internal approvals).
2) We finalize co-sell split and insert into Exhibit v2.
3) DocuSign for the commercial annex once Exhibit v2 is agreed.

I'm looping in Ben (commercial ops) and Karthik (marketplace/co-sell) to address the routing and revenue items.

Attachments: CougarTech_Redwood_Azure_Exhibit_v1.docx (draft), CougarTech_SOW.pdf (draft)

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Azure Marketplace private plan — pricing / co-sell thoughts (internal)

Marissa / Karthik — pulling together my notes on the CougarTech ask. Quick points:

- Pricing and discount: Cougar is asking for a stepped discount at scale (10% at 50 entitlements, 20% at 200). I'm OK with a volume tier but recommend we preserve list price in the Exhibit and capture discounts in an Annex to avoid global pricing leakage.
- Billing routing: Routing to customer tenant is fine but it means we don't get marketplace-level co-sell credits the same way; we'll rely on co-sell credits via the sales plan. If they want reseller billing, revenue recognition and billing cadence change.
- Co-sell split: 70/30 is reasonable starting point but we should confirm with GTM and accounting. Also need to document reporting cadence (monthly usage reports).

Action items for me: draft suggested Annex text for tiered discounts + billing routing language.

On the timeline: 12/9 for legal redlines is tight but doable if we limit to 2 rounds.

— Ben

Quick follow-up on routing and entitlement language — I drafted suggested language for the exhibit that we should push into v2:

1) Entitlement provisioning: "Redwood will provision entitlements within seven (7) business days of purchase notification. Customer is responsible for tenant configuration; Redwood will provide configuration instructions and onboarding support per the SOW."

2) Billing & routing: "Customer may elect marketplace billing to their tenant (Private Offer) or reseller billing. Selecting marketplace billing routes charges through the Azure Marketplace and may affect co-sell program credits; Redwood will provide monthly usage reports to support co-sell reconciliation."

3) Reporting and true-up: "Monthly usage exports will be delivered by Redwood within five (5) business days of month end. Annual true-up will be performed against contracted entitlements."

Also adding a short clause that entitlements are measured in "entitlement units" (defined in the Annex) to avoid ambiguity on seat vs. per-instance usage.

I'll drop these into Exhibit v2 and send to Marissa for customer delivery unless you want another internal pass.

— Karthik

Subject: Final: Azure Marketplace private plan — Exhibit v2 & next steps

Hi Danielle — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is Exhibit v2 which includes the co-sell routing language, entitlement definitions, monthly reporting cadence, and the proposed Annex for volume discount tiers. Key changes from v1:

- Entitlement provisioning SLA: 7 business days (added a short exception for tenant misconfiguration).
- Clarified marketplace vs reseller billing and the implications for co-sell credits.
- Added monthly usage export and annual true-up language.
- Included tiered discount Annex (10% @ 50 units, 20% @ 200 units) as a negotiable commercial annex — this keeps list pricing visible in the main Exhibit.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether Cougar Tech prefers marketplace billing to the customer tenant or reseller billing by 2026-12-16 so we can finalize invoicing flow.
2) If the wording looks good, I can route Exhibit v2 to you via DocuSign (link below) for signatures.
3) Once signed, our onboarding team will target entitlement provisioning within seven business days of purchase confirmation per the SOW.

DocuSign (commercial annex): https://docusign.net/SignLink/COUG-1492
